semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly requests only state transition and output combinational logic using supplied one-hot state.

next_state_sources.S_next: (S or S1 or S110) and not d, or Wait and ack
next_state_sources.Count_next: B3 or Count and not done_counting
next_state_sources.Wait_next: Count and done_counting, or Wait and not ack

moore_outputs.shift_ena: B0 or B1 or B2 or B3

semantics.latency: Combinational propagation only; no clock or storage.
semantics.reset_initialization: Original reset-to-S describes external state storage. No reset or initialization is implemented in this combinational DUT; test reset condition by supplying state=1.

numeric.state: Unsigned 10-bit one-hot vector, S at least significant bit
numeric.signals: Single-bit Boolean logic; no arithmetic or rounding

verification.oracle: Independent transition-table destination per active original state, then collect requested destinations and Moore outputs
verification.coverage: All 10 legal states with all 8 binary input combinations; supplemental all 1024 binary vectors with all 8 combinations to check OR equation extension
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait one time unit for combinational settling
verification.safety: Fatal on any mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.issue: Illegal zero-hot/multi-hot and X/Z state behavior is not explicitly specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use direct one-hot bitwise equations as requested, with OR superposition for binary multi-hot vectors; no recovery FSM or new state storage. Supplemental binary illegal-state tests validate this equation extension, not additional original requirements.
